name: mooter-cockpit
displayName: Mooter — Cost Cockpit for Claude Code
description: See what your Claude Code routing saves — live decisions, tier mix, counterfactual $ savings. Read-only cockpit for the mooter router. Community project, not affiliated with Anthropic.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Read-only over your local mooter telemetry (~/.claude); never executes workspace code.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Needs local filesystem access to read mooter telemetry and run the mooter CLI.

mooter.trackerPort.description: Port of the local mooter savings tracker.

mooter.statusBar.enabled.description: Show the mooter item in the status bar.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Mooter
walkthroughs.description: See what your Claude Code routing saves — in three steps.

steps.title: Install the mooter engine
steps.description:
Mooter routes each prompt to the cheapest capable model. Install the engine, then this cockpit lights up.
[Open Cockpit](command:mooter.openCockpit)

steps.title: Open the Cockpit
steps.description:
Click the 🐮 in the Activity Bar to see live savings, the tier mix, and every routing decision.
[Open Cockpit](command:mooter.openCockpit)

steps.title: Launch a routed session
steps.description:
Start Claude Code with mooter hints active and watch the decisions feed fill in.
[New session](command:mooter.newSession)
